approved_translation: Gratitude should be remembered; do not repay kindness with ingratitude.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: One day while a Lion was eating his dinner a bone stuck in his throat. It hurt so that he could not finish his dinner. Do not forget that once I had you in my mouth, and I let you go. That is all that you can ever expect me to do for you." The Woodpecker said no more, but he kept away from the Lion from that day on.
